beacon.why: The beacon must be unpredictable at contribution time and publicly re-checkable afterwards. A value produced by this project - a block hash from our own Besu chain, for instance - would be worthless, because the project controls it. drand is operated by an external consortium and every round is permanently retrievable by number.
